verdict.rationale: skills.sh's own CLI lets you restore skills from a skills-lock.json lockfile (partly labelled experimental), preview a repo's skills and their instructions before installing (`--list`), and update installed skills. That covers a form of version capture and review. However, no explicit version pinning, diff/review of changes, or rollback command is documented, and community users report that versioning and updating are unsolved. Committing project-scoped skills to git is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit version pinning, a documented rollback-to-prior-version command, change review/diff on update, non-experimental lockfile semantics, independent corroboration of the lockfile workflow.
